title: sasa ontakensis
intro: Sasa ontakensis, commonly known as Sasa quelpaertensis or Sasa breviramosa, is a type of bamboo species belonging to the genus Sasa in the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sasa ontakensis are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit anti-atherogenic effects. The bioactive constituents of Sasa ontakensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
